header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Geotechniek Studio
header.desc: Open-source desktop tool for cone penetration tests (CPT/GEF), borings (BHR/BRO-xml) and site drawings.

what.title: What is Open Geotechniek Studio?
what.desc: Open Geotechniek Studio is a desktop application for visualising and analysing geotechnical data from the Dutch national subsurface registry (BRO). Open any GEF or BRO-xml file and inspect sounding or boring data with automatic Robertson SBT classification, soil layer detection and stratification.
what.list1: CPT soundings (GEF format) — cone resistance, friction, pore pressure
what.list2: Borings (BRO-xml) — soil types per NEN5104, BIMRO/IMBRO/A quality regimes
what.list3: Robertson SBT classification — automatic soil type detection per depth
what.list4: Multi-tab — compare several soundings/borings side by side
what.list5: Map view — all measurements on location (RD coordinates)
what.list6: Reporting — export to PDF for project files

why.title: Why Open Geotechniek Studio?
why.desc1: Geotechnical software in the Dutch market is often expensive and fragmented: different tools for soundings, borings, pile calculations and reporting. Open Geotechniek Studio brings it together — free, open source and fully compliant with Dutch standards (BRO, NEN5104, IMBRO/A).
why.desc2: For the entire civil engineering and infrastructure sector: from foundation engineers to utility contractors, from structural engineers to water-board projects. Read BRO data directly, export to IFCX for BIM integration, and share professional reports without license costs.

standards.title: Supported standards
standards.desc: Open Geotechniek Studio reads and interprets the official Dutch geotechnical formats:
standards.list1: GEF — Geotechnical Exchange Format for CPT soundings
standards.list2: BRO-xml (BHR-GT) — Dutch Key Registry of the Subsurface, geotechnical borehole research
standards.list6: RD coordinates — Dutch national triangulation grid for locations
standards.list7: NAP — Amsterdam Ordnance Datum for ground level and depths

cpt.title: CPT visualisation
cpt.desc: Cone resistance (qc), local friction (fs), friction ratio (Rf) and optionally pore pressure (u2) per depth, with crosshair and value overlay.

bhr.title: BHR borings
bhr.desc: Visualisation of borings with soil layers, admixtures, structure, humus content and colour — directly from BRO-xml.

sbt.title: Robertson SBT
sbt.desc: Automatic Soil Behavior Type classification per Robertson (1990) — from Sensitive fine-grained to Very stiff sand/clay.

layers.title: Soil stratification
layers.desc: Automatic detection of soil layers per depth (top, bottom, zone). Adjust the stratification yourself based on measurements.

map.title: Map view with BRO integration
map.desc: Interactive map with direct BRO integration: search by address and all available soundings and borings around the location load automatically. Click to view details, open in viewer or add to project.

mapLayers.title: Cadastre map layers
mapLayers.desc: Topography (BRT), current and historical aerial photos (2016-2025), addresses and streets, AHN elevation map, cadastral boundaries, BAG buildings and BGT topography — all directly from Kadaster PDOK.

multitab.title: Multi-tab
multitab.desc: Open multiple CPTs and borings in tabs. Compare depth, layers and properties side by side.

report.title: PDF reporting
report.desc: Generate professional sounding reports with selectable sections: cover, coordinates table, overview map, per-sounding pages, Robertson SBT legend and metadata summary. Suitable for project files, permit applications or clients.

situatie.title: Site drawing
situatie.desc: Full drawing functionality for site plans: place soundings and borings, generate sounding grids, RD coordinates, dimension lines, trim/extend/mirror/offset operations. Import images/PDF or SVG frames as reference. Export to professional A3 PDF with OpenAEC title block.

ifc.title: IFC / IFCX export
ifc.desc: Export geotechnical data as IFC elements or in IFCX namespace for seamless integration with BIM models and Open Frame Studio.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.desc: Complete boring and sounding data: registrar, quality regime, drilling method, delivery, description date, NEN5104plus coding.

rawxml.title: Raw data (XML)
rawxml.desc: Inspect the underlying BRO-xml or GEF source directly from the app for verification and debugging.

local.title: 100% local
local.desc: All data stays on your own machine. No cloud, no uploads to third parties — privacy and GDPR by default.

quotes.title: ⚡ Unique: automated quote requests from sounding companies
quotes.desc: Draw a sounding grid on your site plan and click Request quotes. Open Geotechniek Studio searches all Dutch sounding companies in our public catalogue and sends a quote request to the three closest companies, including project details and sounding specifications.
quotes.list3: Pre-selection of the 3 nearest — adjustable before sending
quotes.list4: Outlook integration with pre-filled project info, location and specifications
quotes.list6: Open source catalogue: companies can add themselves via a GitHub pull request
quotes.list1: 43 Dutch CPT contractors in the catalogue (and growing)
quotes.list5: No middlemen, no commissions — direct contact between client and CPT contractor

geotech.title: Geotechnical consultants
geotech.desc: Quickly review BRO data for pile, foundation and settlement advice. Compare multiple soundings for project interpretation.

civil.title: Civil engineers
civil.desc: Underpin foundation choices for bridges, viaducts, tunnels and structures based on CPT plots.

gww.title: Civil infrastructure contractors
gww.desc: Assess excavation depth, soil improvement and dewatering before a civil project starts.

bim.title: BIM coordinators
bim.desc: Integrate geotechnical data into BIM models via IFCX. One source of truth for above and below ground.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: A Rust computation core for fast parsing of GEF and BRO-xml, a TypeScript frontend for the UI, and Tauri 2 for cross-platform distribution (Windows, macOS, Linux). The same stack as the entire OpenAEC ecosystem for seamless integration.
